scientific_integrity: Theorem proved via hub monodromy, a concrete component graph isomorphism, the exact subdivision spanning-tree identity and Fourier matrix-tree eigenvalues; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure multi-petal cycle roses with r>=2 and petal length >=3 only; arbitrary cactus boards not covered. Finite exact checks supplement but do not replace the proof. Historical priority and independence are not certified; Wilson (1974) original full text was not inspected.
title: Cycle-rose sliding puzzles are subdivided discrete tori with an exact spanning-tree product
